description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the 'FreeCheckout' payment extension controller in the OpenCart admin module. It manages the display and saving of the free checkout payment method's settings within the OpenCart admin interface.

classes.name: FreeCheckout
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Free Checkout payment extension in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the settings page for the FreeCheckout extension, including loading language, setting breadcrumbs, and passing data to the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration settings for the FreeCheckout extension, including permission checks and returning JSON responses.
